scope: alpha-next: the seams the owner precheck scans (alpha_next_precheck_conf.SEAMS) that no inherited leaves file named (g4 precheck dry run: 16 undeclared), and the probe launcher sink (g4 engine self-run, HARNESS); hub CPU tests and the CPU engine self-run; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: fix2-removed-mutant
leaves.replaces: engine_driver.NativeSegmentDriver._drive_partial_stop_submission (stop fix 2, the PREPARE replay at a partial acceptance)
leaves.equivalence: a declared mutant, not an equivalent: lambda self: False is the pre-fix behaviour (no replay driven); the tests assert the pre-fix refusal returns, which proves the positive tests depend on fix 2

leaves.name: fix1-reach-probe
leaves.replaces: engine_driver.NativeSegmentDriver._drive_retained_cancel (stop fix 1, the retained-row cancel after a refused successor open)
leaves.equivalence: a reach probe, not an equivalent: the replacement raises AssertionError("fix 1 reached"), showing the fused/grouped stop takes this branch at this state; the witness proper is test_e3_stopfix_refused_open on c3f1f64

leaves.name: driver-leaf-clock
leaves.test: test_alpha_next_stopfix_matrix (fused stop bound exhausted, item-1 stop receipt)
leaves.equivalence: a strictly increasing float iterator: the driver reads clock only to compare against its stop bound (stall_s=0), so the late round exhausts the bound deterministically as it would after real elapsed time; no decision reads absolute time

leaves.name: arm-table-malformed
leaves.equivalence: negative inputs only: out-of-order parts, an unmatched ABBA pair, a repeated arm; T.check() must refuse each; the real table is checked unpatched by the same suite (alpha_next_queue.py --check)

leaves.name: gate-switch-flip
leaves.replaces: e3_alpha_next_box.NUMERICS_IS_GATE / RECEIPT_INTEGRITY_IS_GATE (both False this run, lead 14:29 and 14:5x)
leaves.equivalence: flipped to True only to prove each single constant is the whole switch for next run (the same outside/dirty input turns the verdict FAIL/INC); the shipped values are asserted False unpatched

leaves.name: receipt-read-clean-report
leaves.replaces: e3_alpha_next_box.receipt_read over the grade's followed engine-stream logs
leaves.equivalence: the return value is the real box.receipt_read computed in the same test over a clean writer-framed log; patching only routes that exact report into a grade whose fixture logs carry no receipt records

leaves.name: anatomy-bounds-small
leaves.replaces: handler_anatomy.EVENT_PAIRS / MAX_ROWS (the event pool and row bounds)
leaves.equivalence: smaller bounds (2 pairs, 5 rows) make the pool and row limits bite on a 4-step CPU rig; the bounding code is the same, only the constants are smaller

leaves.name: anatomy-cpu-torch
leaves.equivalence: the stage-1 anatomy fixture torch (stage1_anatomy_fixture_leaves.json, cuda-event leaf): events record and resolve with the same API (record, query, elapsed_time) on CPU

leaves.name: anatomy-leaf-clock
leaves.replaces: executor_hooks.time (the time module the hooks read monotonic_ns from)
leaves.equivalence: a scripted monotonic_ns: the hooks only difference two readings for row times; a fixed increasing sequence gives exact expected rows

leaves.name: receipt-fallback-logger
leaves.test: test_alpha_next_receipts (logger fallback and worker progress sites)
leaves.replaces: executor_hooks._progress_log (the worker progress logger) and native_measurement._RECEIPT_WRITER (the process writer slot)
leaves.equivalence: the logger is a Mock to assert which lines take the logger route; the slot is set to None (no writer: the documented fallback) or to a real ReceiptWriter whose write seam records bytes; both are the emit sites' only two routes

leaves.name: held-g-probe-capture
leaves.test: e3_native41_held_g_probe (held-g frozen probe, its own Capture subclass)
leaves.equivalence: held-g's frozen probe (native41_held_g_fixture_leaves.json): its Capture subclass records the same 'flash-s5 progress ' messages and adds the wait/lean bookkeeping; the checks are the progress probe's own

leaves.name: ring-reader-raises
leaves.replaces: stage_progress.ring_limiting_readers (the C0 ring limiting-reader query, a read for the stage line)
leaves.equivalence: a mutant-parity probe: raising there must change none of the driver counters (the reading never decides); the real query runs unpatched in the same test

leaves.name: lean-digest-forged
leaves.equivalence: held-g's declared mutant: a digest equal to everything shows that without the chain a substituted reply is accepted, proving the chain check is what refuses it

leaves.name: probe-launch-receipt-sink
leaves.replaces: native_measurement.ReceiptWriter's write seam (os.write on the private dup of fd 1, i.e. the container stdout / box engine-stream pipe)
leaves.equivalence: a real ReceiptWriter with write=sink: the sink takes the exact bytes of each record (also copied to fd 2), reads them back with receipt_lines.parse_line, the parser box.receipt_read uses over the engine-stream log, and hands the bare text to the probe's capture handlers; missing seq, bad sha or incomplete records exit 3; unsafe:not-fifo is reported (stdout is a file in the container; the box FIFO proof is owed)
